title: Remove non UTF-8 characters
clean_text:
Title: Remove non UTF-8 characters

Body:
It is better to not introduce any text which is not UTF-8 encoded.


$ grep -axv '.*' Device/ST/STM32WLxx/Include/*


See https://github.com/ARMmbed/mbed-os/pull/15137/commits/5e7a7f4b4eb3f84b0286cb94c415fadff3aff627
